item.title: Bangsamoro Parliament urges PBBM to impose zero tariff for rice imports in Tawi-Tawi
item.description: The Bangsamoro Parliament has called on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to allow traders in Tawi-Tawi to directly import rice from Malaysia tax free to arrest the high prices of the staple in the island-province, which is closer to the State of Sabah than the mainland Philippine city of Zamboanga.
